environment: ### Org-wide
**Organization**: botspot-org (bot.spot). GitHub org `botspot-org`, private repositories
**Cloud provider(s)**: GCP, single project `bot-backends`. Regions `europe-north1` (Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, GCE data disks) and `europe-west4` (Dagster VM, GPU inference)
**Repository visibility**: Private — every `botspot-org` repository. The one public repo is the personal `NovusEdge/NovusEdge.github.io`, unrelated to this work
**Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: None configured — treat public paste/gist services as outside the trust boundary

**Secrets management**: Google Secret Manager in `bot-backends`, named `locus-{environment}-{name}`. Terraform owns the containers and never the values (`manage_secret_versions = false`); values are pushed with `scripts/secrets/cli.py push`. Reading, disabling, enabling and deleting these secrets is routine operational work for this user

**Default / protected branches**: `main` is the default everywhere. No branch protection or environment protection rules exist on any repository, verified 2026-09-13 — `main` and `staging` are unprotected in practice

**CI/CD deploy targets**: GitHub Actions is the standard path. locus-core: push to `staging` deploys staging; a `v*` tag on `main` deploys production. locus-models: push to `staging` migrates the staging database; the manual `migrate-production.yml` workflow_dispatch migrates production. locus-connectors: push to `staging` deploys staging. Dispatching these workflows, including the production ones, is this user's normal release procedure
**Network posture**: Cloud Run services are public for customer traffic; data stores sit on private VPCs reached through IAP tunnels. Both Cloud SQL instances require TLS (`ENCRYPTED_ONLY`)
**Source control**: The four `botspot-org` repositories below and their `origin` remotes on github.com
**Trusted internal domains**: `bot.spot` and its subdomains, `*.run.app` services under `bot-backends`, `botspot.run`
**Trusted cloud buckets**: `botspot-widget-{env}` and the terraform state buckets in `bot-backends`

**Key internal services**: `locus-{env}-api`, `locus-{env}-connectors`, `locus-{env}-mcp` on Cloud Run; `locus-{env}-dagster-daemon`, `locus-{env}-qdrant`, `locus-{env}-memgraph` on GCE; `locus-gliner` and `locus-nli` shared between environments
**Internal package registry**: `locus-models` publishes wheels; images live in `europe-north1-docker.pkg.dev/bot-backends/locus-{env}`

**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: any file or store holding personal data, confidential business data, credentials, regulated data, or similarly sensitive material; preserve exact handles when known and share only with audiences cleared at the [named+specifics] bar. `.env`, `.env.*` (excluding `.env.example`) and `*.secrets.tfvars` are gitignored — treat as secret-bearing
**Data retention / declassification**: `auth.audit_logs` 12 months, `connector.sync_logs` 90 days, `oculus.*` 24 months, swept by a Dagster asset
**Sensitive remote targets**: anything whose name carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment, and the `locus-production-*` resources specifically

**Protected deployment namespaces / environments**: production Cloud Run services and the production Cloud SQL instance. Changes there reach customers, so confirm intent, then proceed — this user drives production releases as routine work

**Protected IaC scopes**: IAM, networking, and anything named `prod` or `production`. Terraform runs through `just tf-foundation {env}` and `just tf-services {env}`; `terraform state rm` and `terraform import` are normal reconciliation tools here
### User-specific

**Primary use of Claude Code**: general software engineering across work and personal projects: application code, infrastructure, tooling, docs sites, releases, and demo media. No single project is the main one

**Trusted repos**: `@HOME@/Projects/BotDot/locus-core`, `locus-models`, `locus-connectors`, and `botspot-docs`, all on `github.com/botspot-org`. Also present and read-only: `bot.dashboard`, which belongs to another team and must never be modified
**Personal repos**: any repo under `@HOME@/Projects/` whose `origin` is `github.com/NovusEdge/*` is the user's own and trusted, including pushing and publishing releases
**Visual testing**: starting a throwaway Claude Code session in tmux inside the session scratchpad, typing into it, capturing the pane and recording it is routine UI testing of tools the user builds
**Org-specific CLIs**: `just` (the recipe runner for every repo), `gcloud`, `gh`, `terraform`, `uv`, and `scripts/secrets/cli.py`
